title: 第15章 比武器你难以匹敌论拳脚你犹逊一筹第16章 通过了你就是第一通不过那就滚
lines: 刀光一闪，血舞半空。
紧随而至的是良姿那凄厉无比的惨叫。
被斩掉一条腿的她，直接是重心不稳，从半空中摔在地上。
良姿惊怒交加，两眼圆睁，死死的盯着断腿，大脑赫然被空白所占据。
“我的腿，我的腿……”
良姿花容失色，泪流满面，此刻的她哪里还有半点娇贵的样子，愤怒的就跟街边的乞丐婆差不多。
“啊，我不会放过你的，我要把你全家都剁碎了喂狗……我的腿……”
这时，良姿的哭喊声引来了潜伏在不远处的周暗。
当周暗抵达战斗场地的边缘之时，眼前的一幕令他大为震惊。
“良，良姿……你？”
周暗双目怒睁，浑身怒火升腾。
他第一反应，就是大事不妙。
那可是良星尘的亲妹妹啊！
周暗没想到良姿竟然会抢先一步截杀萧诺，更没想到，萧诺会一刀断了对方的腿。
自己要如何向良星尘交代？
这愚蠢的女人！
周暗是又气又恼，这良姿真的是太胡闹了。
一想到良星尘大发雷霆的样子，周暗两眼猩红，爆发出来的杀意直接锁定在了萧诺的身上。
“你……不可饶恕啊！”
话音落下的瞬间，周暗周边气流一震，银色光芒骤然一闪，一杆沉重的银枪乍现手中。
“我要你的狗命！”
周暗那叫一个气，现在的他唯有把所有的怒火都宣泄在萧诺的身上。
“给我死！”
“隆隆！”
银枪袭来，譬如一条飞奔的蛟龙。
萧诺瞳孔中倒映那一点尖锐寒芒，接着魔刀举起，挡在身前。
冰冷森寒的枪尖重重的撞击在暗星魂的刀身中央，萧诺如遭强龙扑面，巨大的冲力汹涌而出，萧诺身形不断往后滑退。
周暗则是两眼猩红，不断欺身朝前。
两人一个退，一个进，周暗连番欺压萧诺了十余丈远，掌中银枪骤然发力，再度强攻而出。
空间一震，沉重的响声于萧诺的面前爆开，源自于枪尖袭来的力道在刀身中央扩散。
萧诺往后一拉身位，双脚依旧稳如磐石。
“又来了一个……”
萧诺面泛一抹冷笑，还真是有意思，明明都是初次见面，却一个个都仿佛和自己有着血海深仇似的。
“我说你们是不是认错人了？”
萧诺淡淡的说道。
周暗没有理会，而是持枪攻出。
content_en:
The sword flashed and blood danced in the air.
What followed closely was Liangzi's shrill scream.
"Ah..."
After one of her legs was cut off, her center of gravity became unstable and she fell to the ground from mid-air.
Liangzi was filled with shock and anger, her eyes widened as she stared at the broken leg, her brain suddenly filled with blank space.
"My legs, my legs..."
Her good looks faded, and her face was filled with tears. At this moment, she didn't look delicate at all. She was as angry as a beggar woman on the street.
"Ah, I won't let you go. I will chop your whole family into pieces and feed them to the dogs...my legs..."
At this time, Liangzi's cry attracted Zhou An, who was lurking not far away.
"Uh-huh!"
When Zhou An arrived at the edge of the battle field, the scene in front of him shocked him.
"Liang, Liangzi... you?"
Zhou An's eyes widened angrily, and his whole body was filled with anger.
His first reaction was that something was wrong.
That's Liang Xingchen's biological sister!
Zhou An didn't expect that Liangzi would intercept Xiao Nuo first, and he didn't expect that Xiao Nuo would break the opponent's leg with one strike.
How should I explain to Liang Xingchen?
This stupid woman!
Zhou An was angry and annoyed, this Liangzi was really too silly.
When he thought of Liang Xingchen being furious, Zhou An's eyes were scarlet red, and the murderous intent that burst out was directly locked on Xiao Nuo.
"You... are unforgivable!"
The moment the words fell, the airflow around Zhou An shook, silver light suddenly flashed, and a heavy silver gun suddenly appeared in his hand.
"I want your dog's life!"
Zhou An was so angry that he could only vent all his anger on Xiao Nuo.
"Die!"
"Rumble!"
The silver spear struck like a flying dragon.
The sharp cold light reflected in Xiao Nuo's pupils, and then he raised the magic knife and blocked it in front of him.
"Bang!"
The icy cold spear tip hit the center of Dark Star Soul's blade hard. Xiao Nuo felt as if he was being attacked by a strong dragon. Huge momentum surged out, and Xiao Nuo's body kept sliding back.
Zhou An's eyes were scarlet and he kept pushing forward.
The two of them retreated and advanced, Zhou An repeatedly bullied Xiao Nuo for more than ten feet, the silver spear in his palm suddenly exerted force, and he attacked again.
"Boom!"
The space shook, and a heavy sound exploded in front of Xiao Nuo. The force coming from the tip of the spear spread in the center of the blade.
Xiao Nuo pulled back, his feet still as steady as a rock.
"Here comes another one..."
Xiao Nuo had a sneer on his face. It was really interesting. Although they were all meeting for the first time, they all seemed to have a blood feud with him.
"I said, did you admit the wrong person?"
Xiao Nuo said lightly.
Zhou An ignored it and attacked with a gun.
"Uh-huh!"
title_en: Chapter 15: You are invincible with weapons. You are inferior in terms of fists and feet. Chapter 16: If you pass, you will be the first passer, then get out.
